positions.impact: He would vote for higher taxes on high earners and large fortunes. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

opposes: Current federal immigration enforcement tactics, including detentions of local residents
positions.quote: Fight against an authoritarian federal government that is abducting our neighbors.
positions.impact: He would vote to restrict federal immigration enforcement and oppose funding for current detention practices. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.
